name: Container-Mon
description: Get notified when your Docker containers are unhealthy.

variables.name: Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for checking container health

variables.name: Notification URL
variables.description: Notification URL for Shoutrrr. Multiple services can be used with the | (pipe) character as a separator.

variables.name: Fail Limit
variables.description: Number of consecutive 'unhealthy' checks to reach before sending a notification

variables.name: Use Labels
variables.description: If true, will only monitor containers with the label containermon.enable=true set

variables.name: Notify Health
variables.description: If true will send a notification when an 'unhealthy' container returns to being 'healthy'

variables.name: Check Stopped Containers
variables.description: If true will consider stopped containers as 'unhealthy'. If false, you will only be notified for containers that have a healthcheck set

variables.name: Notification Prefix
variables.description: Custom text to be prefixed to all notification messages.

variables.name: Docker Host
variables.description: Internal path to Docker host. Not recommended to change.
